result.brief: 提出 DriveSTA，用离线生成的带评分轨迹替代方案监督自回归提案生成与残差流精化，并以共享 JEPA 视频特征编码器提供时序上下文，降低推理延迟。
result.reason: End-to-end driving planner with JEPA video-feature representation, proposal-conditioned residual flow refinement and trajectory scoring; representation and flow-based refinement are enabling contributions.
